entities.summary: General Sir Cyril Brudenell Bingham White,, more commonly known as Sir Brudenell White or C. B. White, was a senior officer in the Australian Army who served as Chief of the General Staff from 1920 to 1923 and again from March to August 1940, when he was killed in the Canberra air disaster.
